ranged_attack.name: Fireball
ranged_attack.windup: plants his feet, turns his shoulders side-on and raises his wand at {target}, a tight knot of orange flame swirling and brightening at its tip
ranged_attack.release: flicks the wand forward and a blazing orange fireball with a white-hot core bursts from its tip
ranged_attack.travel: the fireball streaks across the courtyard as a bright orange comet trailing sparks and a ribbon of flame
ranged_attack.impact: it explodes against {target} in a sharp orange-yellow flash and a burst of glowing embers
ranged_attack.decay: the flames shrink and vanish in a split second, leaving {target} in clear view
ranged_attack.again: raises his wand again and hurls another blazing orange fireball that explodes in a bright flash against {target} and vanishes at once
ranged_attack.text: raises his wand at {target}, orange flame gathering at its tip, and hurls a blazing fireball that explodes in a bright orange flash on it and vanishes at once

melee_attack.name: Flame Fist
melee_attack.windup: steps in, twists his hips and draws his right fist back to his side, bright orange flames curling up around his knuckles
melee_attack.impact: his blazing fist crashes into {target} in a sharp orange flash and a spray of glowing sparks
melee_attack.decay: the flames on his fist die out at once
melee_attack.recover: pulls his fist back and settles into a ready stance
melee_attack.again: drives another blazing fist into {target} in a bright orange flash that dies out at once
melee_attack.text: draws back his flame-wrapped fist and drives a blazing punch into {target} in a bright orange flash that dies out at once

dash.name: Ember Dash
dash.text: dashes forward low in a streak of glowing orange embers that scorch the paving
